molsysmt.physchem.get_atomic_radius.claim: Retrieving element-level or ProtOr-typed atomic radii for selected atoms.
molsysmt.physchem.get_atomic_radius.periodic_behavior: Not periodic or not applicable to this contract.

scientific_evidence.oracle: Independently transcribed element-level van der Waals radii for H, C, N, O, and Cl in nanometers.
Published ProtOr typed radii independently assigned to the N, CA, C, O, and CB heavy atoms of alanine.

molsysmt.physchem.get_charge.claim: Reference physical_pH7 group values and sums for Arg/Asp/Ala, and preservation of independently declared OpenMM NonbondedForce particle charges. The Collantes ECI definition remains scientifically unqualified.
molsysmt.physchem.get_charge.periodic_behavior: Not periodic or not applicable to this contract.

scientific_evidence.oracle: Explicit Arg, Asp, and Ala values from the documented physical_pH7 residue scale, including signed system aggregation.
Arbitrary signed particle charges declared directly in an independent OpenMM NonbondedForce.

molsysmt.physchem.get_charge.gap: Under uibcdf/molsysmt#475, primary Collantes/Dunn table values, physical dimension and justified aggregation have not been verified. Legacy values, elementary-charge wrapping and sums are compatibility regression behavior only, covered in tests/physchem/test_collantes_legacy_contract.py; they are not independent scientific evidence.

molsysmt.physchem.get_mass.periodic_behavior: Not periodic or not applicable to this contract.

scientific_evidence.oracle: Independently transcribed standard atomic weights for H, C, N, O, and Cl, with closed-form group and system sums.
Arbitrary particle masses declared directly in an independent OpenMM System.

molsysmt.physchem.get_sasa.claim: Native Shrake–Rupley carbon-sphere SASA against isolated, separated and one-cap overlap analytic constructions; a controlled opposite-face pair under Cartesian and MIC screening, with brute-force/cell-list searches and nm/pm standard units.
molsysmt.physchem.get_sasa.periodic_behavior: A two-carbon opposite-face pair in a 2 nm cubic box agrees with an independent spherical-cap area under MIC and with isolated-sphere areas under Cartesian screening. This does not validate general periodic cells or self-image occlusion.

scientific_evidence.oracle: Sphere area 4*pi*(0.17+0.14)**2 nm**2, with explicit carbon and probe radii.
Equal-sphere accessible area 2*pi*R**2+pi*R*d per atom, R=d=0.31 nm.
MDTraj Topology and Trajectory constructed directly from literal carbon-sphere inputs; public change_radii fixes carbon radius to 0.17 nm.
Equal carbon spheres at 0.1 and 1.9 nm in a 2 nm cubic cell: MIC separation 0.2 nm; accessible area 2*pi*R**2+pi*R*0.2, R=0.31 nm. Cartesian separation 1.8 nm gives full spheres.

molsysmt.physchem.get_sasa.gap: Evidence remains partial: controlled carbon fixtures only. Other elements, general proteins, arbitrary periodic cells, own-image overlap and sampling convergence need separate governed evidence; wrapper-engine agreement is regression parity.

molsysmt.physchem.get_bulkiness.claim: Bounded ALA/GLY/TRP Zimmerman reference area values with physical conversion following Proust et al. (2019), Table 1. Twenty-entry curation parity is separately contract-tested; no coordinate-derived area claim.
molsysmt.physchem.get_bulkiness.periodic_behavior: Not periodic; no coordinates are used.

scientific_evidence.oracle: Independent ALA/GLY/TRP entries 11.5, 3.4 and 21.67 from AAindex1 ZIMJ680102/official ProtScale, with area convention of Proust et al., doi:10.3389/fmicb.2019.00906 Table 1. Source snapshots/hashes: devtools/data/zimmerman_bulkiness_review_20261026.json.

molsysmt.physchem.get_bulkiness.gap: The original 1968 full-text derivation and normalization have not been re-audited. Numeric agreement with curated tables and later published area interpretation do not validate the geometry of a molecular conformation, arbitrary modified groups or molecular area aggregation.

molsysmt.physchem.get_secondary_structur.claim: Reference lookup of sixty dimensionless weighted Levitt P_ij values for twenty standard amino-acid names and three explicit categories, matching detailed Tables III–V; no prediction or observed assignment claim.
molsysmt.physchem.get_secondary_structur.periodic_behavior: Not periodic; no coordinates are used.

scientific_evidence.oracle: Independent visual transcription of Levitt (1978), doi:10.1021/bi00613a026, detailed Tables III–V, P_ij columns. PDF hash, transcription order and curation comparisons: devtools/data/secondary_structure_propensity_review_20261026.json.

molsysmt.physchem.get_secondary_structur.gap: Evidence certifies the bounded reference lookup, not the original population-analysis implementation, prediction accuracy, observed secondary structure, modified-group substitutions or aggregate molecular observables. Additional scale families remain unaudited.

molsysmt.physchem.get_tpsa.claim: Bounded N/O Ertl fragment sums for ethanol, dimethyl ether and acetic acid, with area-unit conversion. Broader form/element-scope checks are contract/provider parity, not permeability validation.
molsysmt.physchem.get_tpsa.periodic_behavior: No coordinates/PBC in graph descriptor; structures are only selection/state context.

scientific_evidence.oracle: Ertl, Rohde, Selzer (2000), doi:10.1021/jm000942e, Table 1, OH=20.23, ether O=9.23, carbonyl O=17.07 angstrom squared. Source review: devtools/data/tpsa_logp_contract_review_20261026.json.

molsysmt.physchem.get_tpsa.gap: Only bounded original-fragment sums independently checked; no general transport/permeability, solvent exposure, metal/radical, arbitrary unsupported chemistry or all-fragment scientific validation. N/O and N/O/S/P remain explicit provider variants.

molsysmt.physchem.get_lipophilicity.claim: Bounded Wildman-Crippen primary atomic sums for methane, ethane and benzene; state-preserving model scores, not logD or a general experimental logP accuracy claim.
molsysmt.physchem.get_lipophilicity.periodic_behavior: Graph descriptor without coordinate/PBC calculation; structures supply selection/state context only.

scientific_evidence.oracle: Wildman and Crippen (1999), doi:10.1021/ci990307l, Table 1: C1=0.1441, C18=0.1581, H1=0.1230. Independent methane, ethane and benzene atomic sums. Author-uploaded primary text inspected 2026-10-27; original method and executed RDKit implementation remain distinct.

molsysmt.physchem.get_lipophilicity.gap: Only three primary atomic-sum controls independently checked. Ionic/zwitterionic/form/H-presentation cases establish contract and provider parity, not experimental partition accuracy, pH-dependent logD, all atom-type validation or a calibrated applicability domain.
